mapper.select: SELECT m1.memberIdx, m1.userId, m1.userPwd, m1.userName, m1.userLevel, m2.profile_photo FROM member1 m1 LEFT OUTER JOIN member2 m2 ON m1.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx WHERE m1.userId = #{userId} AND m1.userPwd = #{userPwd} AND m1.status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member1(memberIdx, userId, userPwd, userName, userLevel, status) VALUES (member_seq.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{userPwd}, #{userName}, 1, 1)

INSERT INTO member2(memberIdx, email, birth, tel, profile_photo, zip, addr1, addr2, gender, pref_position) VALUES (member_seq.CURRVAL, #{email}, TO_DATE(#{birth}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profile_photo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zip, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addr1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addr2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gender}, #{pref_position, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT m1.memberIdx, userId, userPwd, userName, userLevel, status, email, TO_CHAR(birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') birth, profile_photo, tel, zip, addr1, addr2, gender, pref_position FROM member1 m1 LEFT OUTER JOIN member2 m2 ON m1.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx WHERE m1.userId = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member1 SET userPwd = #{userPwd}, userName = #{userName} WHERE userId = #{userId}
UPDATE member1 SET userLevel = #{userLevel} WHERE userId = #{userId}
UPDATE member2 SET profile_photo = '' WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
UPDATE member1 SET status = 0 WHERE userId = #{userId}
